blocks.content: Consistent revision of core concepts is essential for maximizing scores in competitive examinations.

items: Focus on conceptual clarity as examiners frequently test subtle variations of core principles.
Take note of recent updates and factual revisions that are often framed into direct objective questions.
Beware of negative marking by avoiding blind guessing on low-confidence items.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Consistent revision of core concepts is essential for maximizing scores in competitive examinations.
Analyzing previous years' questions (PYQs) reveals recurring themes and high-yield topics.
Developing effective elimination techniques significantly improves accuracy in multiple-choice questions.
Balanced time management across sections ensures full coverage of the question paper.
